title: I had a dream during a long nap today that I was in a "library mall."
content: Like... there were stores and everything like a regular mall, but the walls and even the ceilings (at least the ones that weren't skylights) were all bookshelves filled with books. (I don't know how the books stayed in the ceilings.) I also remember that I had a hard time getting into the mall because one of the exits was closed off and I had to follow signs to the next one. But I eventually got in.
